value.rationale: The update-frequency parameter and fixed primal/dual steps are central tuning quantities for primal-dual splitting. The canonical equal-curvature unit-step test is a structurally natural simplest nondegenerate convex model, not an arbitrary data slice. The result gives an exact continuous-parameter frontier, exhibiting a strictly larger mean-square-stable probability interval than the known sufficient condition as well as exponential rare-update instability and a conserved critical energy. This is a useful sharp benchmark for deciding whether update probability can be reduced while proximal scaling is held fixed; no generic solver or computational-cost advantage is asserted.
